title: Yomu extension descriptor
description: A declarative source adapter. Descriptors carry no executable code: they describe which URLs to request and which paths or selectors to read out of the answer. The Yomu Worker interprets them.

version.description: Bump to publish an update. Yomu reloads a descriptor when this changes.

hosts.description: Every host this adapter may contact, for requests and for images. Enforced at runtime; wildcards-only entries are rejected.

seriesIdFromChapter.description: How to recover the series id from a chapter id, for the chapter manifest's sourceSeriesId. Omit when a chapter id says nothing about its series; the chapter id is then used as-is.

queryParam.description: Read the series id from this query parameter of the chapter id. Tried before regex.

regex.description: Applied to the chapter id; the captured group is the series id.

path.description: Relative to `base`, or absolute within `hosts`. Supports {{page}}, {{query}}, {{rawQuery}}, {{id}}, {{chapterId}} and any derived `vars`.

vars.description: Declarative arithmetic, e.g. turning {{page}} into an offset.

before.description: Request chaining: run first; its first record's fields become {{prefix_field}} variables.

extract.description: Pull a JSON blob out of an HTML page (e.g. __NEXT_DATA__) before parsing.

list.description: JSON path (json) or CSS selector (html) to the repeating element. Omit for a single record.

filter.description: Records must satisfy every filter. Fixed comparisons only -- never an expression language.

chapters.description: Chapters nested inside a series-detail response.

field.description: Recognised names: id, title, author, synopsis, genres, category, status, cover, updatedAt, altTitles, year, anilistId, mangadexId (series); id, number, name, pageCount, publishedAt, scanlator (chapters); url (pages).

path.description: Dotted JSON path. Supports [0] indices and [key=value] predicates.

selector.description: CSS selector, relative to the list item. Empty means the item itself.

attr.description: Read this attribute instead of text.

template.description: Literal with {{placeholders}} from sibling fields and request variables.

many.description: Collect every match rather than the first.

root.description: Resolve `path` against the whole document rather than the current record.

items.description: One of: trim, lower, upper, first, number, pluck, prefix, suffix, join, replace, regex, split, slice, resolve, date, map, default.
